description: Measure how much of your own agent traffic could be saved. NO ACCOUNT OR KEY NEEDED — use this first. Returns byte savings over the wire and, if a query is given, token savings from selective context retrieval. Nothing is stored: the text is compressed in memory and discarded. Rate limited to 20 calls per hour per IP. The response includes a 'trust' section: hosted in Stockholm, no language model called.

dict_id.description: Which trained dictionary to measure against. Call list_packages to see the options and their measured figures.

query.description: Optional. What your agent would search its memory for. Given this, token savings are measured too.

name: measure_traffic
title: Measure possible savings
